profile.summary: Machine Learning Software Engineer with a Ph.D. in mathematics, strong teaching skills, and a proven record solving challenging problems with ambiguous requirements and goals.

positions.title: Postdoctoral Fellow
positions.description:
Published papers on differential and symplectic geometry in top journals, and gave talks at major international conferences and seminars. 

Taught advanced linear algebra (3 semesters), galois theory (2 semesters), and graph theory (1 semester). As the sole instructor for the latter two courses, I had complete creative control over the syllabus, homework assignments, and exams. Won the Frederick V. Atkinson award for outstanding teaching.

Coordinated an introductory calculus course, which entailed leading a team of instructors and TAs to deliver a consistent course over multiple lecture and tutorial sections. 

See gsscott.com for a complete list of publications, conference talks, and teaching materials from past courses.

positions.title: Fellow
positions.description:
Developed a tool to predict a person's destination from their current GPS coordinates, their velocity, and their travel history.

This entails training a neural network on timeseries GPS data, and implementing the algorithm in a web application using Flask, HTML, CSS, Javascript, and d3.js

positions.title: Graduate Student Instructor
positions.description:
Taught calculus for five semesters. Won the "Outstanding Graduate Student Instructor" and "Golden Stapler" awards for outstanding teaching.

Co-coordinated integral calculus for one semester. This entailed mentoring new graduate student instructors and writing exams taken by over 800 students.

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description: Led recitation sessions in Graph Theory, Quantum Mechanics, and Numerical Methods at a postgraduate institution for talented West African math and science graduates. Advised students on research projects.
